howP.en: Mix ratios are the common site figures for hand-graded concrete with 20 mm crushed stone and medium sand: C20 ≈ 330 kg cement/m³, C25 ≈ 370, C30 ≈ 410, with sand and stone making up the rest of the 2400 kg/m³ fresh density. These get you a purchasing quantity, not an acceptance test — the lab mix design on your ticket always wins. Waste of 5% covers pump residue and uneven subgrade; order 8% if the truck has to climb or the pour is thin.
howP.zh: 配比取工地常用经验值（20mm 碎石、中砂）：C20 每方约 330kg 水泥、C25 约 370、C30 约 410，砂石按 2400kg/m³ 湿容重补齐。这个数用来买料，不是验收依据——罐车小票上的实验室配合比永远说了算。5% 损耗覆盖泵管残留和垫层不平；要爬坡或薄层浇筑就加到 8%。

q.en: Why does my lab mix design differ from these numbers?
q.zh: 为什么实验室配合比和这里的数不一样？

a.en: Lab designs are target-mean-strength recipes adjusted for your actual aggregate moisture, grading and admixtures — they routinely use 20–40 kg/m³ less cement for the same grade. Use this page for ordering and budgeting; use the lab design for the actual pour.
a.zh: 实验室配合比按实际骨料含水率、级配和外加剂调过，同标号普遍比经验值省 20–40kg 水泥。这页用来算账订料，实际浇筑以实验室配比为准。

q.en: Site-mix sometimes costs more than ready-mix here. Is that wrong?
q.zh: 自拌算出来比商混还贵，是不是算错了？

a.en: No — it is a real possibility once cement is bought in bags and sand is delivered in small loads. Site-mix wins on tiny pours where a truck cannot reach, or when you already have aggregates on site. What it never saves is labour and time.
a.zh: 没算错——袋装水泥加上小批量送砂，自拌确实经常比商混贵。自拌的意义在罐车进不去的小方量，或者现场本来就堆着料。它省的从来不是钱，是进不了场的尴尬。

q.en: How much waste should I add?

a.en: Pumped slab on flat ground: 5%. Pumped through long lines or up floors: 8%. Hand-buggied small pour: 3–5% is enough. Ordering short is the expensive mistake — a standby truck for 0.3 m³ costs more than the 5% you skipped.
a.zh: 平地泵送留 5%，长距离泵送或上楼 8%，手推车小方量 3–5% 够用。宁多勿少——为补 0.3 方叫一趟车，比省下的 5% 贵得多。

q.zh: 厚度按结构层还是完成面？

a.en: Order by the structural thickness — the stuff you actually pay concrete for. Screed, tile adhesive and levelling compound are a different line item with different materials.
a.zh: 按结构厚度算——那是你真正花钱买混凝土的部分。找平层、瓷砖胶、自流平是另一种材料，走另一笔账。

note.en: One-time. Unlocks footings, columns and multi-pour totals.
note.zh: 一次性买断。解锁基础、柱和多批次合计。
